# LearnQuest visual blocks

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @learnquest/ui-catalog gen`. Do not edit. -->

A visual is one JSON object: `{"v": 1, "blocks": [...]}`.

- `blocks` holds 1 to 12 blocks, each `{"type", "id", "props"}` with no other keys.
- `id` is unique in the spec and matches `^[a-z0-9_]{1,24}$`.
- `props` takes only the keys listed for its type. Every visual block needs `alt` text.
- The whole spec is at most 65536 bytes.
- These types are reserved and never available: `run`.

## Blocks

### diagram

At most 3 per spec.

Prefer `diagram` when a structure is the point: steps in a process, a hierarchy, a cycle, a timeline, relationships.
`kind` is flow, tree, cycle, timeline, graph or labelled. `shape` (rect, round, diamond, circle) is optional and applies to every node.
Up to 30 nodes (id, label up to 60 chars) and 50 edges (from, to, optional label up to 40 chars); every edge must use node ids. `alt` is required: say what the diagram shows.
Example: {"type":"diagram","id":"water","props":{"kind":"cycle","alt":"The water cycle: evaporation, condensation, rain","nodes":[{"id":"sea","label":"Sea"},{"id":"cloud","label":"Cloud"},{"id":"rain","label":"Rain"}],"edges":[{"from":"sea","to":"cloud","label":"evaporates"},{"from":"cloud","to":"rain"},{"from":"rain","to":"sea"}]}}

Props schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["flow","tree","cycle","timeline","graph","labelled"]},"shape":{"type":"string","enum":["rect","round","diamond","circle"]},"alt":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200},"nodes":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":30,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z0-9_]{1,24}$"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":60}},"required":["id","label"],"additionalProperties":false}},"edges":{"maxItems":50,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z0-9_]{1,24}$"},"to":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z0-9_]{1,24}$"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40}},"required":["from","to"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["kind","alt","nodes","edges"],"additionalProperties":false}
```

### image

At most 4 per spec.

Use `image` to show an existing picture from the asset library: {"source":"asset","assetId":"<id>","alt":"...","caption":"..."}.
Only use an assetId you were given. `alt` is required: describe what the picture shows. `caption` is optional.
The "generate" source is not available yet; do not use it.
Example: {"type":"image","id":"pic","props":{"source":"asset","assetId":"ast_pizza","alt":"A pizza cut into 8 equal slices","caption":"8 slices"}}

Props schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","const":"asset"},"assetId":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$"},"alt":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200},"caption":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200}},"required":["source","assetId","alt"],"additionalProperties":false}
```

### text

At most 6 per spec.

Use `text` for a short explanation, definition or caption that no other block covers.
`md` is plain text in paragraphs (blank line between them); only **bold** and *italic* are styled.
No HTML, no headings, lists or images. Links are shown as plain text, not clickable.
Example: {"type":"text","id":"intro","props":{"md":"A **fraction** shows part of a whole.\n\nThe bottom number says how many equal parts."}}

Props schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"md":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000}},"required":["md"],"additionalProperties":false}
```
